customSections.label: Does This Calendar Apply to My School?
customSections.content: This page follows the CMS Traditional Calendar for 2027–28. CMS also publishes separate calendars for CPCC early colleges and middle colleges, UNC Charlotte early colleges, Hawthorne Academy of Health Sciences, and A/B day schedules. If your student attends one of those programs, use that program's official calendar instead.

customSections.label: CMS 2027–28 Grading Period End Dates
customSections.content: CMS lists four grading periods on the 2027–28 Traditional Calendar. These are academic milestones, not days off.

customSections.label: Major Breaks and Long No-School Windows
customSections.content: CMS's official break labels do not always show the full stretch of days students are away from school. These windows combine adjacent teacher workdays, holidays, and weekends.

groups.label: Thanksgiving
items: CMS Thanksgiving Break is November 25–26, 2027. Students are also scheduled to be out Wednesday, November 24 for a teacher workday, creating a November 24–28 no-school window including the weekend.

groups.label: Winter Break
items: Winter Break runs December 20–31, 2027. Students return Monday, January 3, 2028.

groups.label: Spring Break
items: Spring Break runs April 10–14, 2028. April 17 is scheduled as a teacher workday and is also CMS's fourth-listed makeup day. If CMS does not activate it as a makeup day, students are scheduled to return Tuesday, April 18.

customSections.label: CMS Makeup Day Order
customSections.content: CMS lists five possible makeup days, in this order. A listed date becomes an instructional day only if the district activates it to make up missed school. The superintendent may waive up to four makeup days, and state law also allows remote instruction for certain emergency closures.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2026–27
content: The first day moves from August 25 in 2026 to August 24 in 2027.
Spring Break moves from March 29–April 2 in 2027 to April 10–14 in 2028.
The scheduled last day moves from June 9 in 2027 to June 7 in 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When does CMS start school in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day on the CMS 2027–28 Traditional Calendar is Tuesday, August 24, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CMS Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: CMS Spring Break runs April 10–14, 2028. April 17 is a scheduled teacher workday and the fourth-listed makeup day. If CMS does not activate it as a makeup day, students are scheduled to return Tuesday, April 18.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CMS Winter Break in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break on the CMS Traditional Calendar runs December 20–31, 2027. Students return Monday, January 3, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CMS Thanksgiving Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: CMS Thanksgiving Break is November 25–26, 2027. Students are also scheduled to be out Wednesday, November 24 for a teacher workday, creating a November 24–28 no-school window including the weekend.

calendarFaqs.q: When are CMS teacher workdays with no school?
calendarFaqs.a: After the first day of school, CMS lists teacher workdays on October 11, October 29, November 1–2, November 24, January 24, February 21–22, March 7, March 31, April 17, and June 8–9. January 24, February 22, March 31, April 17, and June 8 are also possible makeup days, so families should check CMS updates after a closure.

calendarFaqs.q: Does every CMS school follow this calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. This page follows the CMS Traditional Calendar. CMS publishes separate 2027–28 calendars for CPCC early colleges and middle colleges, UNC Charlotte early colleges, Hawthorne Academy of Health Sciences, and A/B day schedules.

calendarFaqs.q: What happens to the calendar if CMS closes for bad weather?
calendarFaqs.a: CMS may close schools, open on a two-hour delay, dismiss early, or use remote learning during severe weather. Check the CMS Inclement Weather page, the district homepage, and ParentSquare for current announcements. The Traditional Calendar lists possible makeup dates in a specific order.
